passages.provision_quote: Section 38. Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Enrolled text of the single-subject joint resolution printing the operative constitutional provision.
House third-reading roll call listing Heaton among the Yeas on a divided 57-40 vote.
Official bill-details page naming Heaton as a co-author of the resolution.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye

rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its House third reading (57-40, not near-unanimous), a single-subject joint resolution whose whole operative content is "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That text matches both clauses of the rung that would "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman": it defines marriage as one man and one woman and denies validity or recognition to same-sex marriage. The rungs that allow same-sex marriage or reserve marriage while recognizing civil unions are excluded by an instrument that makes no same-sex marriage valid in Indiana.
